name: Domain Decomposition Scene Representation
definition: A model-parallel approach for large-scale volumes where a single network is replaced by a domain decomposition of models, each learning a separate brick of the volume. Models are arranged in a grid and require no communication during training or inference.
summary: Domain Decomposition Scene Representation partitions volumetric data into fixed-size bricks, each modeled by a dedicated neural network, enabling parallel training and inference without inter-process communication.
